description.zh: 为用户授权该权限模板的原因。
description.en: The reason why you want to grant permissions on resources to the users by using the permission template.

description.zh: 权限到期时间。时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss。
description.en: The time when the permission expires. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.
The ID of the permission template.

description.zh: 租户ID。可通过调用[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

description.zh: 待授予模板权限的用户ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of users to which you want to grant permissions on resources by using the permission template.

title.zh: 授予用户权限模板中的资源权限

descriptions.zh: 您在数据管理DMS中的系统角色为管理员或DBA。查看系统角色的具体操作，请参见[查看我的系统角色](~~324212~~)。
descriptions.en: You must be a database administrator (DBA) or a Data Management (DMS) administrator. For more information about how to view system roles, see [View system roles](~~324212~~).
